ontology.note: Design alignment to GenericInputConfiguration; not a claim that current receipts emit this type.

changes.description: The pin editor's map takes the room the dialog has instead of a fixed 400 px, and Full screen gives it the whole window with the pin's form still beside it. Siting a pin is reading the ground around it -- which river, which road, which workings -- and the small window made that a sequence of zooms rather than a look.
